title: Спадкові джерела та імпорти
fields_and_relations: Партія, raw records, джерельні parent/position, прогрес імпорту й неоднозначності.
required_interaction: Імпорт/повтор/помилка; raw record незмінний, відсутній сеанс не реконструюється.

implementation.view_model: Source creation, UTF-8 CSV/TSV import with mapping and preview, immutable originals and records, hierarchy/order/labels, idempotent retry and changed-source batches, source documents and inventory filters.
limitations: Browser-local CSV/TSV UTF-8 import: up to 500 records and 2 MiB per input or original file; actual storage capacity depends on the browser.
Word/XLSX/scans are preserved as original documents; automatic native parsing and OCR are not implemented. Use CSV exports for batch spreadsheet inventory.
Physical presence, inscriptions, location and urgency are explicitly recorded by a person; no automatic Session/Person/Genre reconstruction or rights/publication changes.
implementation.state_storage: Shared browser store; legacy batches and inventory are added lazily without resetting existing user data.
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
